title: CrazyOptimizer
description: this mode pack will help you get some real fps
body:
🔥 PvP & SMP Performance Modpack

This modpack is designed to deliver maximum performance, smooth gameplay, and competitive advantage for Minecraft PvP and SMP servers. It focuses on boosting FPS, reducing lag, and improving responsiveness—without changing vanilla mechanics or giving unfair advantages.

Whether you’re crystal PvPing, playing Bedwars, or grinding on an SMP, this pack ensures stable performance even during intense fights and large bases.

⚡ Key Features

🚀 High FPS & Low Latency – Optimized rendering, lighting, and memory usage

🧠 Smart Performance Tweaks – Reduces stutters, lag spikes, and chunk loading issues

⚔️ PvP-Friendly – Smooth combat, faster input response, and clearer visuals

🌍 SMP Optimized – Handles farms, redstone, and multiplayer environments efficiently

🧩 Vanilla-Friendly – No gameplay changes, only performance and quality improvements

🔧 Lightweight & Stable – Works well on both low-end and high-end PCs
